title: One debt question, asked by every door
action: OPEN P1 from the review session's second delta re-review, reproduced live by the reviewer: the feature-swap door calls featureSwapGuardFeatureVerifyDebt and featureSwapGuardScribingDebt but never asks testCellDebt (packages/bee/bee.mjs ~:2918-2928). REPRO (reproduce it yourself first, scratch repo, CLI-only writes): feature `alpha` with a capped change_class 'behavior' cell and NO test cell at all -> `bee state set --feature beta --owner swarming --waive-scribing-debt` returns EXIT 0 and the feature becomes beta; the identical state refuses via `state set --phase scribing` (EXIT 1) and via `start-feature` (EXIT 1). CONTEXT YOU MUST HONOUR: this is the THIRD round on this surface. Round one guarded the phase door and missed the swap door. Round two guarded the swap door for feature-verify debt, added a shared debt core in packages/bee/lib/state.mjs (readFeatureCellsStrict / isDebtGuardedDeparture / featureVerifyDebt / testCellDebt), and still left the swap door assembling its own subset of questions. A third round that adds one more call in one more place will be outflanked the same way. FIX: make the question singular — ONE entry point that answers 'does this feature owe anything?' over the whole debt set, and every door (phase departure, feature swap, startFeature) calls exactly it; no door composes its own list. Waivers keep their existing scope: a --waive-scribing-debt must not waive an unwaivable debt. Derive the test coverage from the debt set (iterate it) rather than hand-listing pairs, so a debt kind added later is inherited by every door AND by the tests. You MAY run packages/bee/tests/test_bee_cli.mjs, packages/bee/tests/test_cli_state.mjs and packages/bee/tests/test_state.mjs, and must quote all three. GIT SAFETY (shared checkout, sibling worker live): commit through your OWN temp index (GIT_INDEX_FILE + read-tree/update-index/write-tree/commit-tree/update-ref); NEVER plain git add, NEVER reset/stash/checkout/restore.
